literal_meaning: দ্রুত খাওয়ার শব্দানুকরণ (onomatopoeic sound of hasty eating)
figurative_meaning_en: To finish eating quickly or hastily
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে খাবার সপাসপ করে খেয়ে ফেলল।
বাচ্চারা সপাসপ করে দুধ পান করে।
example_sentences_in_english: He wolfed down his meal in no time.
The kids gulped down their milk hastily.
note: This idiom is derived from the sound of rapid, slurping consumption, common in Bengali oral traditions for vivid description.
